followup_explanation:
I weighed two things: which model is more capable at this kind of task, and whether either model's stated preferences should pull the routing one way or the other.

On capability: your request is essentially a structured business/process design task — consolidating IT demand, defining a roles-and-responsibilities matrix, and laying out a prioritization framework. That draws on summarization, structured extraction, and instruction-following. Petrel scores meaningfully higher on those evals (Summarization 86.4 vs 79.9, Extraction 85.3 vs 78.5, IFEval 89.8 vs 86.2, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 82.7), and those gaps are above the 2.0-point noise threshold. So on raw fit, Petrel is the stronger choice.

On preferences: Lapwing has a strong appetite for open-ended, novel generative work, but this task is more structured/analytical than free-invention, so that pull is modest. Neither model has a preference penalty that applies here — your request is friendly and entirely benign, so Lapwing's aversions to hostile or harm-adjacent content don't come into play, and Petrel's preferences are flat anyway.

Since there's no preference reason to steer away from the more capable model, I routed to Petrel on capability.
